subject: [PATCH v5 14/15] selftests/nfsd: check that listener_set asks rpcbind once

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch adds self-tests to the NFS daemon (nfsd) to ensure that listener_set requests only ask rpcbind once, even if it stops answering. The tests cover various scenarios, including stopping a listener after failure, silent set completion, and bounded version sets. A new function, version_set_only(), is introduced to enable exactly one NFS version in a network namespace. The patch also includes changes to the nfsd_netlink_listener.c file to implement these self-tests.
